import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv', 
                           names=['Person ID', 'Gender', 'Age', 'Occupation', 
                                  'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                                  'BMI Category', 'Blood Pressure', 'Heart Rate', 
                                  'Daily Steps', 'Sleep Disorder'])

# Convert Blood Pressure column to numeric values
sleep_health['Blood Pressure'] = pd.to_numeric(sleep_health['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/').str[0], errors='coerce')

# Filter out missing values in Blood Pressure
sleep_health = sleep_health.dropna(subset=['Blood Pressure'])

# Plot the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.show()

# Plot the distribution of Daily Steps across different Age groups
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxenplot(x='Age', y='Daily Steps', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of Daily Steps across different Age groups')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Plot the distribution of BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='BMI Category', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()

# Save the final figure as output.png
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.heatmap(sleep_health.corr(), annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation Matrix')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_health)

plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.show()

# Plot the distribution of Daily Steps across different Age groups
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
